clauses.label: A
clauses.title: Scope of Services
clauses.text: Redwood Group shall provide the services described in Exhibit A (the "Services") to Delta Solutions in a professional and workmanlike manner, consistent with industry standards. Any changes to the scope of the Services must be agreed in writing by both parties before work begins.

clauses.label: B
clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.text: In consideration of the Services, Delta Solutions shall pay Redwood Group fees not to exceed $125,000 per invoice period. All invoices are payable within 15 days of receipt. Amounts unpaid after the due date accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

clauses.label: C
clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 15 days' written notice to the other party. Either party may terminate immediately upon a material breach by the other party that remains uncured 15 days after written notice of the breach.

clauses.label: D
clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: All work product created by Redwood Group specifically for Delta Solutions under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Delta Solutions upon full payment of the applicable fees. Redwood Group retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, and methodologies.

clauses.label: E
clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Delaware.

clauses.label: F
clauses.title: Independent Contractor
clauses.text: Redwood Group is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employment relationship between the parties. Redwood Group is solely responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and employee obligations.

clauses.label: G
clauses.title: Entire Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement, together with its exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between Delta Solutions and Redwood Group with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties.
